Non-ozone-depleting compounds such as HFCs, hydrofuoroolefns, and other EPA-approved alternative refrigerants are used to replace ozone-depleting refrigerants. Many HFC compounds are potent GHGs, and some EPA- approved alternates to HFC refrigerants are fammable or toxic compounds such as propane or ammonia. NREL uses refrigerant-containing “appliances” (i.e., sealed units that do not normally emit refrigerants) such as comfort cooling systems, research environmental chambers and experimental equipment, and small appliances such as refrigerators, coolers, and air conditioners.
